    Who are the judges for American Idol 2026?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    For the 2026 season of American Idol (Season 24), Carrie Underwood, Luke Bryan, and Lionel Richie returned as the celebrity judges, with Ryan Seacrest continuing as host. The season, which began in early 2026, also featured guest judges like Keke Palmer during the Top 20 Hawaii rounds. 
    This video shows a behind-the-scenes moment with guest judge Keke Palmer mentoring a contestant:
    59s
    American Idol
    YouTube• Mar 23, 2026
    Key Details for 2026 Season (Season 24): 
    • Judges: Carrie Underwood, Luke Bryan, and Lionel Richie.
    • Host: Ryan Seacrest.
    • Premiere Date: The season kicked off on January 26, 2026, on ABC.
    • Theme: The season focused on "Idol University" to find the next generation of music icons.
    • Guest Mentors/Judges: Keke Palmer and Brad Paisley assisted during the Top 20 Hawaii episodes.
    • Returnees: This marked Underwood's second season as a judge, and Bryan/Richie's eighth season. 
    The season featured a "Top 20" competing in Hawaii with judges and guest mentors before viewer voting began to decide the finalists.
